scope: Independent arithmetic and decision inputs from six completed raw-artifact audits; no timing execution or new corpus qualification.

method.absolute: Per-pair second elapsed time minus baseline elapsed time; all pairs retained.
method.interval: Copied from the frozen independently rerun source auditor, not newly bootstrapped here.
method.controls: Same-code A/C pairs are separately recomputed, never subtracted.
method.scope: Ordinary complete import and nested or overlapping owning-phase counters remain separate.

jmdict.phaseScope: parserSourceInflateMs includes inflation and immediate whole-bank CRC. parserSourceCrcMs measures deferred CRC inside parsing, not inflation. Keep these diagnostic counters separate; do not add them or substitute them for browser totalImportMs.
